compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is part of a "Favourites" section where users can select their preferred gaming platform. The current platform selected is "Playstation 3." There is a "Change" button next to the platform name, which, when tapped, opens a dialog box titled "Select the platform." The dialog box presents a list of options for different gaming platforms, including:

- Playstation 3 (currently selected)
- Playstation 4
- Xbox 360
- Xbox One
- PC
- Mobile phone

At the bottom of the dialog box, there is a "CANCEL" button to close the selection dialog without making any changes.
